description: One app's requirements (Cloudflare plan, hosts, settings), price, versions, stage ("beta" or "stable") and what's included. Tell the owner the requirements, and that the app is in beta when it is, before they buy. price_text is the price in plain words (the cents are in prices and price_list); cloudflarePlan is the Cloudflare plan the app needs ("free" = the Cloudflare free plan, not the price); plan is deprecated and repeats it.

app_id.description: Same as app (the name the account tools use). One of the two is required.
